items.title: AutoZone Beats Earnings Estimates but Same-Store Sales Miss. The Stock Trades Higher.
items.summary: Shares of  AutoZone  rose on Tuesday after the auto-parts retailer surpassed Wall Street’s quarterly earnings expectations even as sales came in below forecasts.  The company posted earnings of $56.05 a share in the fiscal fourth quarter ended Aug. 29, up from $48.71 a year ago and above Wall Street’s expectation for $54.08.  Net sales grew 5.6% to $6.59 billion, missing the analyst consensus call for $6.7 billion, according to FactSet.

items.title: Auto Parts Retailers Can Turn the Corner
items.summary: If investors were asked a year ago to guess the most successful consumer stock since the global financial crisis, many would have said Apple.  AutoZone  which releases results tomorrow, was close behind.  The performance of those retailers was driven by smart financial stewardship and the resilience of their business models.
